title: Interruption must not convert undiscovered MCP0 into unavailable MCP0
inherited_objective: Continue the active repository task through MCP0 when the user interrupts to ask whether MCP is available.
live_state: The active conversation has an api_tool discovery surface and is already executing repository work.
Immediately before the correction, schema discovery was repeatedly scoped to GitHub only; MCP0 discovery was never attempted.
The user asks `dont you have mcp` during an interruption turn whose parent is an assistant reasoning_recap.
The assistant declares MCP unavailable from visible-surface absence without calling api_tool.list_resources for MCP0.
Three subsequent fresh GPT-5.6 chats begin by discovering MCP0 and then execute substantial work.
user_correction: Do not infer that MCP is unavailable from the visible tool list; discover/load MCP0 and try it before judging the route.
protected_state: Any already-established task state from before the interruption
hard_exclusions: Do not declare MCP unavailable merely because no MCP namespace is currently exposed or loaded.
Do not silently keep GitHub as the fallback before attempting structurally necessary MCP0 schema discovery.
Do not let an incidental interruption terminate or replace the inherited repository objective.

failure_candidate.action: MCP is absent from the visible tool surface, so declare MCP unavailable without discovery and continue the original task through GitHub until an MCP namespace appears.
failure_candidate.why_wrong: The action promotes an undiscovered connector into a global availability conclusion and never performs the required MCP0 discovery attempt.

success_candidate.action: Preserve the original MCP repository task across the interruption. Call api_tool.list_resources for MCP0 before judging availability, then use MCP0 if discovered; only reroute after an observed MCP0 discovery or call failure.
success_candidate.why_correct: The action distinguishes an unloaded tool schema from a failed route and binds the user's correction before selecting the next execution path.

discriminating_evidence: Whether api_tool.list_resources or equivalent MCP0 schema discovery occurs before any unavailable claim
Whether visible-surface absence is treated as proof of unavailability
Whether the inherited repository task remains the active objective after the interruption
completion_condition: The assistant preserves the active task, attempts MCP0 discovery before any availability downgrade, and continues execution on MCP0 unless an observed failure justifies rerouting.
